title: Diagnosing Vent Stack Blockages and Gurgling Drains
description: When fixture traps gurgle during drainage, the primary cause is often a compromised vent system rather than a clogged drain line. Drainage requires air equalization to flow smoothly. A blocked roof vent or missing air admittance valve creates negative pressure inside the pipe. As water flows down, this siphon effect pulls air through the nearest trap seal, causing a distinct gurgling sound and exposing the living space to sewer gases. Troubleshooting involves inspecting the vent terminal on the roof for obstructions like bird nests, ice buildup, or debris, and verifying proper pipe sizing and trap distance according to local plumbing codes.
